```sql
WITH somerset_region AS (
  SELECT geometry
  FROM regions
  WHERE region_name ILIKE 'Somerset County'
    AND border_type = 'county'
    AND addr_state = 'NJ'
),
mean_elevation_somerset AS (
  SELECT
    ST_Union(r.rast) AS rast
  FROM
    public.dem_us r
  WHERE
    ST_Intersects(r.rast, somerset_region.geometry::geometry)
),
mean_elevation_value AS (
  SELECT
    ST_ValueCount(mean_elevation_somerset.rast, true) AS stats
  FROM
    mean_elevation_somerset
),
nature_reserve_point AS (
  SELECT
    ST_SetSRID(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-74.512049 40.625497)'), 4326)::geometry AS geom
),
elevation_at_nature_reserve AS (
  SELECT
    ST_Union(r.rast) AS rast
  FROM
    public.dem_us r
  WHERE
    ST_Intersects(r.rast, nature_reserve_point.geom)
),
elevation_value AS (
  SELECT
    ST_Value(elevation_at_nature_reserve.rast, 1, nature_reserve_point.geom) AS elev
  FROM
    elevation_at_nature_reserve, nature_reserve_point
)
SELECT
  'Stransky Nature Trails' AS name,
  elev
FROM
  elevation_value, mean_elevation_value
WHERE
  elev > (SELECT stats.mean FROM mean_elevation_value.stats);
```
